note: The learning path (Learn > Path). For each HSK level: units, each an ordered list of topic names (from content/topics.json / data/hsk*-webs.js) and grammar stops {"g":"<lesson id>"} (lesson ids from data/hsk*-grammar.js). tools/build-path.py turns this into data/path.js and checks it. A word that is in several topics goes to the first topic of the path that has it, unless 'place' says where it belongs (the target may be any topic of the path, even one that does not list the word). 'names' gives a name to a stop made by merging tiny topics (key: the topic names joined with ' + '). 'splits' cuts a big topic into named stops by hand (the last one may leave 'words' out to take what is left); other big topics are cut evenly into stops of at most 6 or so words.

1.title: HSK 1
1.blurb: The 300 words of HSK 1, from hello to joining sentences.

units.title: Say hello
units.blurb: Greet people, be polite, and say who you and they are.

units.title: Be, ask, say no
units.blurb: Say what something is, ask who and what and yes-or-no questions, and say no.

units.title: Names and this and that
units.blurb: Ask and give a name, point at things, and put the words in order.

units.title: Counting
units.blurb: Count, give a price or an age, and say how many of something.

units.title: People you know
units.blurb: Talk about friends, family and what people do.

units.title: Describing things
units.blurb: Say what is good, big or small, and how much.

units.title: Time and days
units.blurb: Say the day, the date and the time, and describe your day.

units.title: Eat, drink, shop
units.blurb: Order food and drink, ask a price and buy things.

units.title: Places and getting around
units.blurb: Say where things are, where you are going and how you get there.

units.title: School and Chinese
units.blurb: Talk about school, studying Chinese, and phones and computers.

units.title: Free time and feelings
units.blurb: Talk about the weather, hobbies and films, and how you feel and think.

units.title: Doing things
units.blurb: Say what you do, can do, want to do, and what is happening now.

units.title: Linking it together
units.blurb: Join people and ideas: and, also, all, together, with, to.

2.title: HSK 2
2.blurb: The 197 new words of HSK 2, with the grammar that goes with them.

units.title: People and family
units.blurb: Introduce yourself and talk about family and people.

units.title: Counting and time
units.blurb: Count more things, and say when and how often.

units.title: Eat, drink, shop
units.blurb: Talk about food, drinks, colours, clothes and money.

units.title: Home and school
units.blurb: Talk about your home, your school, studying and the internet.

units.title: Places and directions
units.blurb: Say where places are and which way to go: left, right, in, out.

units.title: Roads and trips
units.blurb: Say how far, how you travel, and where you have been.

units.title: Body and free time
units.blurb: Talk about your body, health, sports, hobbies and the weather.

units.title: Feelings and actions
units.blurb: Say how you feel and what you hope, start and finish things, and how things are done.

units.title: Wanting and comparing
units.blurb: Say what could happen, what you hope, and compare things.

units.title: Connecting ideas
units.blurb: Give reasons, set choices side by side, and join sentences.

units.title: How long and how often

units.title: Food and shopping

units.blurb: Name places in a city, say where things are, and use the compass.

units.title: Travel
units.blurb: Find your way, ride transport and travel abroad.

units.title: School and study
units.blurb: Talk about school, subjects, exams, and using the internet.

units.title: Nature and weather
units.blurb: Describe the weather, mountains, plants and animals.

units.title: Fun and social life
units.blurb: Talk about hobbies, parties, gifts, sport and meeting people.

units.title: Body and feelings
units.blurb: Describe your body, health, feelings and character.

units.title: Thinking and saying
units.blurb: Say what you think, know and understand, and talk about it.
